creativeGrammar.mainIdentity: Scout a small area and identify the target egg and patrol risk.

a.material: Risk-reward escape mechanism with dynamic environment interaction
a.materialDomain: Environmental hazards, player perception, and adaptive behavior patterns
a.stateChange: Player gains awareness of environmental risks while maintaining stealth

b.material: Multiple path options with varying levels of danger and reward
b.materialDomain: Path complexity, resource distribution, and spatial constraints
b.stateChange: Player selects an optimal escape route based on current threat level and available resources

creativeGrammar.abCausality: Player choice affects both system dynamics and environmental response, creating emergent gameplay mechanics that evolve over time

abEvolution.aChangesB: Increased environmental hazard density triggers new escape strategies
abEvolution.bChangesA: Optimized path selection reduces perceived risk but increases exposure to hidden threats
abEvolution.lateGameChange: System integration creates self-sustaining escape sequences

materialFusion.contrast: Dynamic environmental interactions create unpredictable escape outcomes
materialFusion.causalBridge: Player perception of risk influences both system navigation and environmental responses
materialFusion.removalConsequence: Loss of escape routes leads to increased environmental hostility and strategic adaptation

storyCausalChain.characterConflict: Environmental hazards introduce uncertainty in player strategy
storyCausalChain.playerChoice: Player decides between stealth or direct confrontation
storyCausalChain.worldChange: Escape route becomes a dynamic environment with evolving risks and rewards
storyCausalChain.nextEvent: Player must adapt to new environmental conditions while maintaining stealth

local_authoring_parts::2bcafdcc5ed4f319f.playerFantasy: 플레이어는 잠입과 탈출에 대한 전략적 숙련을 통해 환경의 위험과 기회를 예측하며, 단순한 행동보다 더 복잡한 선택과 결과를 경험하게 된다.
local_authoring_parts::2bcafdcc5ed4f319f.coreFun: 플레이어는 작은 지역에서 목적지 알리미를 확인하고, 타겟 계란과 경보 리스크를 식별하는 과정에서, 실제 상태 변화와 피드백을 즉시 경험할 수 있는 핵심 행동을 수행하여, 다음 전략 및 경로를 실제로 달라지는 경험을 반복한다.
